method: Read-only trace audit: each recorded nitro event was mapped from observed.progress through the original attempt-9 city Track.sample; current, middle, and ahead curv[] samples were checked against RaceDriver.frame straight/nitro thresholds. No browser/game state was changed.
limitation: The trace records snapshots at roughly 100 ms intervals; 120 Hz points in the 300 ms interval are reconstructed by linear interpolation of observed.progress, speed, heading, and lateral offset before resolving original Track.sample/curv values. Trace snapshots omit instantaneous native flags (airborne, spin, slowTime, wrongWay, recovery), so this confirms geometry, speed, heading, centeredness, steering release, and non-drifting evidence around each emitted natural nitro event; fixture test evidence remains necessary for other safety predicates and collision-recovery negatives.
